name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and runs Nginx as a multi-site HTTP/HTTPS server for test.cluster.local, ci.cluster.local, and status.cluster.local, with per-site document roots, static landing pages, TLS certificates, and security hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, a listener on port 6379, service enablement, and supporting directories and configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI application from GitHub with Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a virtual environment, database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
